H4851.d: A man of the Syrians living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.23
s: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and «Mash».
And their dwelling was from «Mesha», as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no «strife», I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

H4854.d: A man of the Arabs living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.14

s: But Samson’s wife was given to his «companion», whom he had used as his friend.
Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his «friends», and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth «deceit».
A «false» balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.

H4886.d: to smear, anoint, spread a liquid; (Niphal) to be anointed
s: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and «anointed» him, to sanctify him.
In the first «chariot» were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

H4864.d: uprising, utterance, burden, portion, uplifting; that which rises, uprising, uplifting, signal, rising; utterance, oracle; burden; portion, present, largesse, gift, contribution, offering, tribute
s: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke «rise» up out of the city.

H4847.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.11
s: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and «Merari».
The range of the mountains is his «pasture», and he searcheth after every green thing.

H4843.d: to be bitter; (Qal) to be bitter; (Hiphil) to make bitter, embitter; (TWOT) to be strong, strengthen
s: Behold, for peace I had great «bitterness»: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

H4872.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.2.10
s: And «Moses» was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
And Miriam and Aaron spake «against» «Moses» because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

H4871.d: to draw; (Qal) to draw; (Hiphil) to draw
s: He sent from above, he took me; he «drew» me out of many waters;
And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their «kneadingtroughs» being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and «bitter» «herbs».
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to «destroy» it for the old hatred;

H4813.d: A woman of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.15.20;; elder sister of Moses and Aaron; a woman of Judah
s: Remember what the LORD thy God did unto «Miriam» by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.
And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare «Miriam», and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

H4809.d: § Meribah = "strife" or "contention"; a fountain at Rephidim, in the desert of Sin; so called because the Israelites murmured against God; the name of the water supply at Kadesh on the southern border of the promised land; the people also murmured here against God
s: They angered him also at the waters of «strife», so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of «Meribah»;
Then thou shalt take an «aul», and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

H4853.d: load, bearing, tribute, burden, lifting; load, burden; lifting, uplifting, that to which the soul lifts itself up; bearing, carrying; tribute, that which is carried or brought or borne
s: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for «burdens»:
The «burden» of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

H4888.d: ointment (used to consecrate by anointing); anointing portion
s: Oil for the light, spices for «anointing» oil, and for sweet incense,

H4865.d: plaited or filigree or chequered work (of settings for gems)
s: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be «set» in ouches of gold.
And thou shalt make it an oil of holy «ointment», an «ointment» compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
And if thy oblation be a meat offering «baken» in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

H4899.d: anointed, anointed one; of the Messiah, Messianic prince; of the king of Israel; of the high priest of Israel; of Cyrus; of the patriarchs as anointed kings
s: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his «anointed».
Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of «thine» «anointed».
Saying, Touch not «mine» «anointed», and do my prophets no harm.

H4838.d: to scour, polish; (Qal) to scour, polish; (Pual) to be scoured
s: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both «scoured», and rinsed in water.

H4803.d: to bare, polish, make smooth or bald or bare; (Niphal) to be made bald
s: And the man whose «hair» is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

H4817.d: chariot, place to ride, riding seat; chariot; seat (of a litter), saddle
s: And what «saddle» soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
Thou shalt drink also water by «measure», the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

And upon them that are left «alive» of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

H4848.d: Someone descended from Merari who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.11
s: Of «Merari» was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the «rebellious» house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

H4874.d: loan; of loan released in the 7th year

s: When thou dost lend thy «brother» any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge.
They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with «bitter» destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

H4846.d: bitter thing, gall, poison; gall, gall-bladder (seat of gall); poison, venom; bitter thing; bitterness
s: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are «bitter»:
And their border went up toward the sea, and «Maralah», and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
And out of the tribe of Asher, «Mishal» with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

H4857.d: drawing place of water, place to draw water
s: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the «places» of «drawing» «water», there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and «broth» of abominable things is in their vessels;
Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your «fat» beasts.
And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and «fatlings».
As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a «far» country.

H4869.d: high place, refuge, secure height, retreat; stronghold; refuge (of God)
s: The LORD also will be a «refuge» for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: «Misgab» is confounded and dismayed.
For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me «about»: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

H4800.d: broad or roomy place, wide, expanses
s: He brought me forth also into a large «place»: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

H4834.d: to be or make sick; (Niphal) to be grievous or painful; (Hiphil) to make sick
s: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a «grievous» curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a «pavement» of stones.

H4866.d: place of breaking forth, place of breach, opening; of womb
s: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the «birth», and there is not strength to bring forth.

H4877.d: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.34
s: And «Meshobab», and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

H4812.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.6;; grandfather of Ahitub, descendant of Eleazar the son of Aaron, and the head of a priestly house; son of Ahitub, father of Zadok, descendant of Eleazar the son of Aaron, and the head of a priestly house …
s: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat «Meraioth»,

H4821.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.10
s: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and «Mirma». These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

H4807.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.4;; another name for Mephibosheth; son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul

H4810.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.4;; another name for Mephibosheth; son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul
s: And the son of Jonathan was «Merib»-baal: and «Merib»-baal begat Micah.

H4824.d: § Meronothite = "joyful shouter"; a native of a place probably called 'Meronoth'
s: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the «Meronothite»:

H4832.d: health, healing, cure; healing, cure; health, profit, sound (of mind); healing
s: For they are life unto those that find them, and «health» to all their flesh.
For the sons of Athaliah, that «wicked» woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of «oil», and salt without prescribing how much.

H4873.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.2.10
s: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of «Moses».

H4822.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.8.33;; a priest, son of Uriah of the family of Koz active in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and in the 7th course of temple service in the time of Ezra and Nehemiah; a priest in the time of Zerubbabel …

H4898.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.4;; ancestor of Meshullam who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem; perhaps the same as 2 and 3; a head of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; perhaps the same as 1 and 3 …
s: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of «Meshezabeel». And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
And Pethahiah the son of «Meshezabeel», of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

H4855.d: lending on interest, usury; in Ne 5:11, the rate of "usury" was only one per cent
s: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this «usury».

H4811.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.12.12
s: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, «Meraiah»; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

H4825.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.14
s: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, «Meres», Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king’s face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)

H4826.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.14
s: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, «Marsena», and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king’s face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)
Behold, this is the «joy» of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my «gall» upon the ground.
And be it indeed that I have erred, «mine» «error» remaineth with myself.
To satisfy the «desolate» and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? «canst» thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

H4841.d: a seasoning, compounding, spice-seasoning; ointment pot
s: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea «like» a «pot» of «ointment».
Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou «castedst» them down into destruction.

H4830.d: pasturing, pasturage, shepherding; pasturing, shepherding; pasturage; flock (meton)
s: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my «pasture»! saith the LORD.
Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the «beauties» of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

H4878.d: turning away, turning back, apostasy, backsliding
s: I will heal their «backsliding», I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
The way of the slothful man is as an «hedge» of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the «hedge» thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
Whose hatred is covered by «deceit», his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

H4823.d: trampling place, trampling; trampling place; trampling
s: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the «mire» of the streets.

Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the «saw» magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for «violence», to do it.
Go up against the land of «Merathaim», even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his «destroying» weapon in his hand.

H4897.d: a costly material for garment; perhaps silk
s: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with «silk».
Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with «bitterness» sigh before their eyes.
It shall be a «place» for the «spreading» of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a «place» to «spread» forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
Of the oaks of Bashan have they made «thine» «oars»; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
And all that handle the «oar», the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

H4804.d: to pluck, pull off; (P'il) to be plucked off
s: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were «plucked», and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and «hatred» in the house of his God.
